sections.text: Yuvraj #2 gained 6.95 to reach 54.03 on the ARC-AGI-2 public board, moving from 42nd to 39th in the past day.
The latest gain extends a climb reported yesterday, bringing the team closer to the board's top tier. Public standings remain provisional.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
